notes.title: Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune has released!
notes.content: [p]You can now buy Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667850/Silk_Roads_II_Paths_of_Fortune/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]5 years after the release of Silk Roads: Caravan Kings, I'm so pleased to announce the official launch of Silk Roads II. Being able to revisit this fascinating slice of history and create the game I wanted to build 5 years ago has been nothing short of amazing and I appreciate everyone who's been along for the ride, I hope you pick it up and see just how far it's come.[/p]

notes.title: Silk Roads: Caravan Kings is going free!
notes.content: [p]To celebrate the announcement of the launch date for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667850/Silk_Roads_II_Paths_of_Fortune/"]Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune[/url] of August 1st, I wanted to do something special, so I thought, why don't we give away Silk Roads: Caravan Kings for free?[/p][p][/p][p]Now, there's a period of time of one week between when I can announce the game is going free and when I can offer it for free, but if you had been contemplating purchasing Silk Roads: Caravan Kings, I strongly encourage you not to. This also means, you will have one whole week of free Silk Roads: Caravan Kings before the launch of Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune.[/p][p][/p][p]This will have no effect on those who had picked up Silk Roads: Caravan Kings prior to the event, though I do want to especially thank you for all of your support that got me to the launch of Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune.[/p]

notes.title: Try the demo for Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune!
notes.content:
[p]Travel across the legendary Silk Roads as you build a caravan of merchants, mercenaries, and misfits. Manage your party, trade historical goods, and navigate the dangers of a vast and shifting world, all while carving out your own path to fortune. [/p][p]Try the Demo here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667850/Silk_Roads_II_Paths_of_Fortune/"][/dynamiclink]
If you enjoy the demo, wishlist the game and let me know what you think. Every bit of feedback helps shape the road ahead. Thanks for being part of the journey![/p]

notes.title: Wishlist Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune
notes.content:
Today we launched the Steam page for the sequel to Silk Roads: Caravan Kings, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667850/Silk_Roads_II_Paths_of_Fortune/][b]Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune[/b][/url].

Silk Roads II: Paths of Fortune builds on all of the features from the original, while expanding them in so many ways. Return to the world of medieval trade and ambition as you: 
[list]
[*] Build a caravan of unique characters and animals
[*] Manage the day to day of your camp
[*] Explore and trade across an open world in any direction 
[*] Play through dynamic events as the world changes around you.
[/list]

This immersive trading simulation expands on the beloved original with deeper systems, dynamic world events, and a rich cast of characters to command and contend with.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667850/Silk_Roads_II_Paths_of_Fortune/][b]WIshlist it today to play the demo first![/b][/url]

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618040/be1cb989c6f068a8cd2cf081ab52c846e145fc99.png[/img]
[h1][b]Achievement Update[/b][/h1]
We had always planned for [b]Silk Roads: Caravan Kings[/b] to include achievements but were confronted by several technical limitations. These limitations have been overcome with [b]The Great Plague Exodus[/b].

As Priory Games gears up for the launch of [b]The Great Plague Exodus[/b] later this week I have managed to find some time to backdate our new Steam achievements functionality to include 18 achievements for [b]Silk Roads: Caravan Kings[/b] and an additional 2 hidden achievements, adding greater replay-ability even for the most hardened [b]Silk Roads: Caravan Kings[/b] fans.

Feel free to leave comments below for suggestions of further achievements.

notes.title: Major New Years Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618040/f15fefb540386fcc1aca4cccf551ae6095b59846.png[/img]
[h1][b]Greetings Merchants![/b][/h1]
As Priory Games gets ready to launch [b]The Great Plague Exodus[/b] on February 5th, I will be hunkering down to bug fix/polish. So I wanted to go all out with a major [b]Silk Roads: Caravan Kings update[/b], since we'll be busy with the new game for a while. Therefore, I’ve made some huge quality of life upgrades, introduced some community requested features and rebalances along with the usual bug fixes.

[b][h2]The New Year update:[/h2][/b]
[h3][b]Game Speed Setting[/b][/h3]
A massively requested community feature. The game now has a speed setting at the bottom of any travelling scene with Normal (x1), Fast (x2) & Super (x4).
[h3][b]Increased Contract Time[/b][/h3]
Added an extra 300 days to the standard contract time. Players should have an easier time making the full journey.
[h3][b]Made Events Repeat Less Often[/b][/h3]
The game now stores the 20 most recent events and removes them from the event selection pool, this will hopefully decrease how often you see the same events. This will not effect Europe or Winter events though due to the possibility of crashing.
[h3][b]Added Social Links[/b][/h3] 
Making it easier for players to find each other and share stories or tips.
[h3][b]Doubled XP required for levelling up skills[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Fixed Event Bugs[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Fixed End Game Scroll[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Optimised Audio Files [/b][/h3]
Decreasing the install size quite a bit.

This is by no means the end for [b]Silk Roads: Caravan Kings[/b], it has been a lot of fun to revisit and play test for this update and I’m really impressed with the state of the game as a first development for Priory Games, but my skills as a developer have come a long way in the short period of time since the game launched and I’m very excited to show you what’s coming up next.
